events.title: Asheville Jewish Film Festival
events.description: @ The Asheville JCC is pleased to be a sponsor of this year’s Asheville Jewish Film Festival. About the Oct 10 & 11 Film: Once Upon My Mother is the story of Esther and her family. In 1963, Esther gave birth to Roland, the youngest sibling of a large Moroccan Jewish family that had emigrated to Paris. Roland was born with a clubfoot that prevented him from standing. Against everyone’s advice, she promised her son that he would be able to walk just like everyone else and have a wonderful life. [trimmed]
